name: Rougier Devonte Williams
profile: Ambitious and customer-focused automotive professional with hands-on experience at BCA, developing practical expertise in vehicle handling, dealership drop-offs, MOT and service movements, vehicle testing, polishing and customer handovers. Experienced working around a wide range of premium and performance vehicles, including Mercedes-AMG, Ferrari, McLaren, Aston Martin, Porsche, Maserati, Bentley, Range Rover, Jaguar, Lotus, Audi RS and BMW M models.

Alongside my automotive experience, I have a strong background in high-value sales and business development. At Curve Media, I sold premium promotional packages through cold calling, targeted email outreach and direct prospecting, building relationships with decision-makers including artist and football representatives and business owners. This developed my confidence, persistence, commercial awareness and ability to identify and convert sales opportunities.

I am now looking to expand my skill set and progress into automotive sales. I am ambitious to develop my knowledge of vehicles, finance, customer experience and the complete sales process while learning from experienced professionals and building a long-term career within the automotive industry.
